Logical Model: ECG derived result model

Official URL: http://hl7.eu/fhir/ecg/StructureDefinition/EHDSECGDerivedResult Version: 0.1.0-ci-build
Draft as of 2026-11-06 Computable Name: EHDSECGDerivedResult

Copyright/Legal: Copyright HL7 Europe. Licensed under creative commons public domain (CC0 1.0).

One envelope for measurements, diagnostic statements, AI inferences and other derived biomarkers. The meaning of a non-standard result lives in a versioned definition (EHDSECGBiomarkerDefinition). Typical Core uses: the global measurement set (type measurement-set, one component per LOINC measurement) and the diagnostic statement set (type statement-set, one component per SNOMED CT finding).

Usages:

  • Use this Logical Model: ECG examination model and ECG result document model

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
